title: Set Theory
text:
PMATH 434: Set Theory
Description: ZFC axioms, well-orders, ordinals, regular and singular cardinals, the cumulative hierarchy, Boolean algebras, ultrafilters, club and stationary sets, measurable cardinals, the reflection principle, Gödel's constructible universe, ordinal definable sets.
Requirements: Prereq: PMATH 432
